system.description: Per-card Vital Bracelet routes for the 28 cards added in step 7 (DIM, DIM vol. 0.5, Primeval Warriors and BEMemory cards). Collected 2026-11-12 by research agents, mainly from humulos.com detail pages (device 13 = VB DIM/EX cards, 14 = Vital Bracelet BE / BEMemory cards). Each edge is a route between two species of the card, with its kind (normal, fallback, jogress, timeOnly, adventure), the stated requirements and the source text. Third-party quotes: review before a public release (see README). Routes of seven species restored on 2026-11-13 (Huckmon, Bao Huckmon, Savior Huckmon, Arresterdramon: Superior Mode, Kodokugumon, Tailmon (Child), Ghilliedhumon) were read from cached humulos detail pages and carry a note.

loogamon.deviceRules: Vital Bracelet BE card (humulos 'Loogamon', JP May 2023 Premium Bandai). BE rules: PP (from squat training) replaces Trophies; timers Baby I 1h, Baby II 3h, Child 12h, Adult 24h, Perfect 24h. Fallback routes exist only for Bowmon (->Herissmon), Herissmon and Bemmon (->Damemon); Loogamon (Child) and every Adult and Perfect have no fallback, so when nothing is met the evolution timer resets and is checked again (humulos manual). Adventure Mission gates: Bemmon (Stage 1), Snatchmon (Stage 4), Destromon (Stage 8), Ragnamon (Stage 12). Fenriloogamon: Takemikazuchi is reached only by Jogress with Kazuchimon from the Pulsemon BE Memory card (cross-card; per the BE manual the partner must be in backup as the Support Digimon). Among the Ultimates only Fenriloogamon evolves further.

espimon.deviceRules: Digivice -V- Dim card (humulos 'Espimon', JP Aug 2022 Retail, Set -V3-; details device 13). VB Dim rules: Trophies, Child timer 16h. Cotsucomon -> Kakkinmon is time-only. Kakkinmon -> Ludomon needs 1,200+ VV, otherwise (0-1,199 VV, the exact complement) Espimon, recorded as fallback. Ludomon and Espimon both fall back to Black Tailmon Uver. No Adult or Perfect has a fallback. Each Adult has 3 stat routes plus 2 attribute-Jogress routes to Perfects, and each Perfect has 2 stat routes plus 1 attribute-Jogress route to an Ultimate (the device checks the backup for a Digimon of the same stage with a different/listed attribute when evolving IV->V or V->VI, humulos manual). Bryweludramon -> Ragna Lordmon only by Jogress with Durandamon from the Ryudamon Dim (cross-card; Durandamon is not in this input). No Adventure gates on this card. The humulos chart page omits the attribute-Jogress routes; they come from the detail pages. Digitamamon also appears on the Ancient Warriors card and Ragna Lordmon on Ryudamon; only Espimon routes are listed.

kudamon.deviceRules: Vital Bracelet BE card (humulos 'Pulsemon', JP Feb 2024 Premium Bandai); the card's lead Child is Pulsemon although the app line id is kudamon. BE rules (PP, Child 12h). Bibimon -> Kudamon is given only as '0-499 Vital Values' (no 'Choose one'), which is not the exact complement of Pulsemon (5+ PP, 500+ VV) and Shoutmon (Stage 3, 5+ PP, 1,000+ VV): a Bibimon with 500+ VV and 0-4 PP meets none of the three, and humulos says nothing beyond the manual's timer-reset rule. Kudamon -> Blade Kuwagamon is the only Child fallback; Pulsemon and Shoutmon have none, nor does any Adult or Perfect. Adventure gates: Shoutmon (Stage 3), Shoutmon X4 (Stage 6), Omega Shoutmon (Stage 8), Shoutmon DX (Stage 11), Shoutmon X7 (Stage 12). Fenriloogamon: Takemikazuchi comes from Kazuchimon only by Jogress with Fenriloogamon from the Loogamon BE Memory card (cross-card). Source conflict: the chart page draws a line Shoutmon X4 -> Metallife Kuwagamon, but the detail pages (Shoutmon X4, Blade Kuwagamon and Metallife Kuwagamon, consistently in both directions) list Blade Kuwagamon -> Metallife Kuwagamon and no Shoutmon X4 -> Metallife Kuwagamon; the detail pages (which also match the app's Wikimon edge) were used.

gammamon.deviceRules: Vital Bracelet BE / BEMemory rules (humulos vbbe manual + device=14 details pages), which differ from the DIM cards: the stat is PP instead of Trophies; BE Memories have 12 Adventure stages (not 15), and several routes need a specific stage cleared (Bokomon stage 2, Koemon stage 3, Sealsdramon stage 6, Vamdemon stage 9, Kuzuhamon stage 11, Arcturusmon stage 12). Attribute jogress ('Vaccine Adult', etc.) from original Dim cards does not work on the BE; only named-partner jogress works, and this card has exactly one: Siriusmon + Arcturusmon (both from the Gammamon BE Memory Dim) -> Proximamon. humulos lists Proximamon as Stage VI+ (Super Ultimate), while our data has it as Ultimate. Fallbacks: Gurimon -> Gammamon ('Choose one: 0-2 PP, 0-499 Vital Values, Stage 2 not cleared, No requirements', so Gammamon is the default while Adventure stage 2 is uncleared) and Gammamon -> Gulus Gammamon ('Choose one: 0-4 PP, 0-499 Vital Values, 0-2 Battles'). Unlike the DIM cards' standard Child stage, Bokomon and Koemon have NO fallback (Bokomon: Betel Gammamon or Sealsdramon (stage 6); Koemon: Kaus or Wezen Gammamon); no Adult or Perfect has a fallback either. If nothing is met the timer resets and re-checks (humulos manual). BE timing (manual): Baby I 1h, Baby II 3h, Child 12h (16h for original Dim cards), Adult and Perfect 24h; PP can no longer be earned after the 100-hour timer, so evolution then stops. The card also has Ghilliedhumon, which is not in our species list: Wezen Gammamon -> Ghilliedhumon (10+ PP, 2,500+ VV, 10+ Battles, 50%+), Ghilliedhumon -> Cannondramon (12+ PP, 3,000+ VV, 15+ Battles, 50%+), Ghilliedhumon -> Spinomon (10+ PP, 2,500+ VV, 15+ Battles, 60%+). agumonblack.deviceRules: Standard Vital Bracelet DIM rules per humulos (vbdm manual + this card's details pages): Baby I -> Baby II -> Child are time-only. Child -> Adult has three stat routes (Trophies / Vital Values / Battles) plus one fallback, listed by humulos as 'Choose one: 0-4 Trophies, 0-599 Vital Values, 0-2 Battles' (any one of those = the lowest stat route failed). Adult -> Perfect and Perfect -> Ultimate have no fallback: if no route is met when the timer ends, the timer resets and the check repeats (humulos manual). Attribute jogress ('Jogress with Data Adult', etc.) means a Digimon of that stage and attribute registered in backup when the timer ends; humulos manual: the device checks backup for a same-stage, different-attribute partner when evolving IV->V and V->VI. Requirements count only what was earned in the current stage. Adventure Mission routes need the card's Adventure stage cleared (DIM cards have 15 stages). Card specifics: Agumon (Black) -> Monochromon is the fallback. Omegamon Zwart is the Stage-15 Adventure Digimon (stat route from Metal Greymon: Alterous Mode/Mametyramon/Metal Greymon (Virus), jogress routes from Ex-Tyranomon/Vermillimon/Skull Greymon, all with Stage 15 cleared). Two routes are either/or ('Choose one'): Ex-Tyranomon -> Victory Greymon (stats OR Jogress with Data or Free Perfect) and Vermillimon -> Gaioumon (stats OR Jogress with Vaccine or Free Perfect); each is listed as two edge entries (normal + jogress). Black War Greymon -> Omegamon Zwart is a named-partner jogress (Metal Garurumon (Black) from the True Shadow Howl Dim), the only Ultimate -> Ultimate route. Data anomaly: humulos's Metal Greymon (Virus) and War Greymon pages list a 'Mad Black Roar' route Metal Greymon (Virus) -> War Greymon (10+ Trophies, 4,500+ Vital Values, 15+ Battles, 50%+ Win Ratio), but War Greymon is not in humulos's Mad Black Roar chart or War Greymon's own card list (Agumon EX, Dinosaur Roar), and it is not in our species for this card; not included as an edge.

gabumonblack.deviceRules: humulos treats the set as two Dims; this line is 'True Shadow Howl' (Set Vol.0.5, the Gabumon (Black) half; its partner Dim is 'Mad Black Roar'). Requirements use Trophies; 15 Adventure stages. Punimon->Tsunomon->Gabumon (Black) are time-only. Gabumon (Black)->Drimogemon is the fallback (0-4 Trophies, 0-599 Vital Values or 0-2 Battles); Garurumon, Garurumon (Black) and Dorulumon need stats. No fallback after Child: Adult->Perfect and Perfect->Ultimate only happen when a requirement set is met; otherwise the evolution timer resets and conditions are re-checked after the same interval (humulos manuals). Four Adult->Perfect pairs are 'Choose one' (stats OR Jogress): Garurumon (Black)->Were Garurumon: Sagittarius Mode / Pandamon / Were Garurumon (Black), and Dorulumon->Cerberumon; each is written as two edges (normal + jogress). Omegamon Zwart: Stage 15 + stats (from Were Garurumon: Sagittarius Mode, Were Garurumon (Black), Jaeger Dorulumon), Stage 15 + attribute Jogress (from Cerberumon, Pandamon, and the left-out Rhinomon), or Metal Garurumon (Black) + Black War Greymon from the Mad Black Roar Dim (named-partner Jogress, no stage condition listed; Ultimate->Ultimate). Rhinomon (Armor, left out by the app) is on this card with 8 routes, listed in leftOutRoutes; dropping it removes a stat route from Drimogemon and Dorulumon. Two app edges (Dorulumon->Were Garurumon (Black), Garurumon (Black)->Jaeger Dorulumon) exist only on the 'Wolf Howl' Dim, not on this card. Jogress partners are given only as stage + attribute (e.g. 'Vaccine or Free Adult'). humulos VBDM manual: when evolving Stage IV->V or V->VI the device checks backup for a Digimon of the same stage and a different attribute and, if present, Jogresses. humulos BE manual: attribute-only Jogress from original Dim cards does not work on the Vital Bracelet BE.

angoramon.deviceRules: Vital Bracelet BE Memory 'Angoramon' (JP Jan 2023, retail). Requirements use PP instead of Trophies; BE Memories have 12 Adventure stages, and a route locked behind a stage is hidden until that stage is cleared (humulos BE manual). PP can no longer be earned after the Digimon's 100-hour timer. No Jogress on this card. Pyonmon->Bosamon is time-only. Bosamon->Angoramon is the fallback (0-4 PP, 0-999 VV, or Stage 2 not cleared); Bosamon->Dracumon needs Stage 2 cleared + 5+ PP + 1,000+ VV. Angoramon->Dogmon is the fallback (0-7 PP, 0-4 Battles or 0-999 VV). Dracumon has NO fallback: Dogmon needs 10+ PP/1,000+ VV/8+ Battles and Sangloupmon 12+ PP/1,500+ VV/10+ Battles. No fallback after Child: Adult->Perfect and Perfect->Ultimate only happen when a requirement set is met; otherwise the evolution timer resets and conditions are re-checked after the same interval (humulos manuals). Adventure locks: Dracumon (Stage 2), Publimon (4), Phelesmon (6), Oleamon (9), Bastemon (10), Piemon (12, every route). The same target can need different stats from different sources (e.g. Marsmon from Cerberumon needs 60%+ win ratio and from Mephismon 20+ PP/2,500+ VV; Grand Dracumon from Cerberumon needs 20+ PP, from Matadrmon/Phelesmon 35+ PP).

Named-partner Jogress works on the BE; there are no attribute-only Jogress routes on this card. The app has Alphamon: Ouryuken as a species but no edge into it. Monzaemon needs 40%+ win ratio from Deltamon but 30%+ from Numemon.

ghostmon.deviceRules: Original Vital Bracelet Dim card (humulos device 13). Pattern on this card: Baby I->Baby II->Child are time-only ('No requirements'); Child->Adult has 3 stat options plus one fallback (humulos 'Choose one: 0-4 Trophies / 0-599 Vital Values / 0-2 Battles', all N/A on the chart); Adult->Perfect and Perfect->Ultimate have stat routes and attribute-based Jogress routes and NO fallback, so a Digimon can stall there; one Ultimate is locked behind Adventure stage 15 (the card's last area). Jogress partner text names only attribute + stage (e.g. 'Virus Adult'); humulos manual: at Stage IV->V and V->VI the device checks backup for a Digimon of the same stage but a different attribute and, if present, Jogresses; only the active Digimon evolves. Manual timer table: I 1h, II 3h, III 16h, IV 24h, V 24h, VI 3h; only Trophies/Battles earned in the current stage count. Card specifics: fallback is Ghostmon->Bakemon. Neo Vamdemon is the Adventure-15 Ultimate. Wizarmon, Baalmon and Beelzebumon (2010) pages are shared with the Impmon GP card; only groups headed 'Dynasty of the Evil' or 'DEv, Imp GP' were used.
